name: Orikasa Yue
source:
"I want to be me because I've decided to love myself."

Mashiro's classmate. She's in the Track and Field Club. She hates crookedness and is usually the type to speak clearly, but is only ever cold to Mashiro - especially when she's with Yuu. She seems to avoid Kuro, and if she gets close to her, her face will turn red and she will run away.

When she was young, her grandparents and parents forced her to eat whatever she could get her hands on.

[Translated from [url=http://mikatuki.sakura.ne.jp/m/contents/character/img/chara_yue.png]official website[/url]]
